https://na.finalfantasyxiv.com/lodestone.description: A seasonal quest in Old Gridania featuring a bear costume and six furnishings.
steps: Start We Scare Bears with the Pumpkin-headed Apparition in Old Gridania (X:10.2 Y:9.4).
Follow the seasonal quest objectives and continue the quest chain to obtain the costume.
Visit the event vendors for available furnishings and returning items. Finish seasonal quests before the event ends.
rewards: Grisly Bear Head and Grisly Bear Suit (costume).
Smiling Wakeshroom; Staring Wakeshroom; Wakesoul Buggy (furnishings).
All Saints' Wake MMXXV Advertisement; All Saints' Wake MMXVI Advertisement; Tabletop All Saints' Wake MMXXV Advertisement.
notes: Checked against the official event page and official Community Team blog on 2026-10-18. Vendor prices are not listed here.

https://na.finalfantasyxiv.com/lodestone.title: Fall Guys Collaboration
https://na.finalfantasyxiv.com/lodestone.description: Play Blunderville, earn Manderville Gold Saucer Fame (MGF), and exchange it for prizes.
requirements: Level 15+; Gold Saucer access via It Could Happen to You (requires your city-state's envoy main scenario quest).
steps: Unlock Gold Saucer: Well-Heeled Youth, Ul'dah - Steps of Nald (X:9.6 Y:9.0).
Complete Just Crowning Around: Lewena, Gold Saucer (X:4.8 Y:6.1). Returning players can resume directly.
Join Blunderville shows for MGF; exchange it at MGF Trader, Blunderville Square (X:3.8 Y:3.1).
rewards: Gentlebean Knit Cap / Parka / Bottoms / Shoes: 410 MGF each.
Matte Winner's Crown / Glossy Winner's Crown: 410 each.
Blunderville Crown / Flag / Donut Bumper / Padded Wall / Rainbow / Hammer: 220 each.
Everybody Falls (Fall Guys Theme) Orchestrion Roll: 220.
Blunderful / Blunderous / Blunder-villed Framer's Kit: 200 each.
Standard Rationing Manual / Gold Saucer Aetheryte Ticket: 200 each.
notes: All prices are MGF. Earn MGF during the event.
